info.syllabusName: Visual Design Tools 1_Công cụ thiết kế trực quan 1
info.description:
The course empowerC14ommon Adobe 2D tools for Multimedia designers, which are Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and Xd, so that they can finalize their 2D designs better and able to deliver completed professional product to customers

Through practical assignments, students have chances to apply knowledge on colors, typography etc. in other courses along with computers and other tools to creaate graphic applications. In addition, students will be introduced to the application of AI tools in design workflows, developing AI literacy to enhance creativity and collaboration. The course also emphasizes the cultivation of a professional attitude and working style, preparing students for real-world design projects and industry practices.
info.studentTasks:
- Read textbook and install software before coming to class

- Complete assignments in class, submit online thoughout LMS or Classroom platform.

- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

- Actively participate into class, review and comments to classmate works, ask instructor questions, bring into class everyday samples for references.

- Complete homework and other requirements by instructors

- Using laptop in class only for taking note, research and doing assignment purposes

- No talking, surfing, chatting, gaming, facebooking, using phone etc. while the teacher giving instruction.

- Present at least 80% class attendance in order to pass the course.
info.tools:
1. The school prepare: (Installed)

- Classroom with chairs, desks, large monitor with HDMI connection for demo/presentation

2. Student prepare:

- Note/Sketchbooks, pens and pencils

- Laptop for graphic design with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and Indesign installed

- Suitable Generative AI tools

Students are required to use their personal account (not the university or organizational account) to register for an Adobe account.

clos.loDetails: Understanding of vector, bitmap, and layout principles, together with essential design principles as the basis for creating effective 2D design products.
Apply Adobe Illustrator proficiently to create vector-based design products such as logos, icons, and illustrations…
Apply Adobe Photoshop proficiently to develop bitmap-based design products such as photo edits, digital paintings, and visual effects…
Apply Adobe InDesign proficiently to produce layout-based publishing products such as brochures, magazines, and posters…
Apply AI tools and demonstrate AI literacy to collaborate effectively.
Having a positive attitude and a professional working style.

assessments.note: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions.

assessments.questionType:
Students will receive the assignment instructions and requirements directly from the instructor.
The task is to design a vector-based graphic product (ex: logo, icon, pattern, or vector illustration...) using Adobe Illustrator.

Students are provided with a sample vector-based graphic product or may propose one for instructor approval.
Students are required to reproduce the product using Illustrator tools and submit the work at the end of the session.
Submission includes the original working file (.AI), and exported outputs in required formats.
assessments.knowledgeSkill:
Master basic and advanced Illustrator tools for vector drawing.
Develop the ability to transform creative concepts into vector-based products: logo, icon, pattern, vector illustration.
assessments.note: This is the first assignment using the design tool, student are required to provide evidence that the work was created independently and to show their ability to create, manipulate, and export graphic files according to the assignment requirements.

assessments.clo: CLO1, CLO2, CLO3, CLO5, CLO6, CLO7, CLO8
assessments.questionType:
Students will receive the assignment instructions and requirements directly from the instructor.
Create a media graphic product: poster, social media content, promotional design... using Adobe Photoshop.
AI integration.
Option 1 (AI as Idea Partner)
Students will use one or more AI tools to generate ideas for a specific media graphic product.
Students are then required to recreate the AI-generated idea using Photoshop tools.
Submission must include: Original Photoshop working file (.PSD), exported outputs in the required formats and documentation of the AI-generated idea.

Option 2 ( AI as Creative Element Generator):
Students may first propose their own product idea, discuss and confirm it with instructor.
After idea approval, students will use Photoshop to create the final product, while being allowed to use AI tools to generate supporting elements.
Submission must include: Original Photoshop working file (.PSD), exported outputs in the required formats and documentation of the AI-generated idea.
assessments.knowledgeSkill:
Use Photoshop tools effectively for image editing, photo manipulation, and digital compositing.
Produce creative outputs such as posters, social media graphics, or promotional materials.
assessments.note: This project must be completed at home, and students are expected to integrate AI tools responsibly into their creative process.

assessments.questionType:
Students will receive the assignment instructions and requirements directly from the instructor.
Design a layout project:brochure, magazine spread, or template for digital or print publishing...

Students will be given a layout brief or may propose one for instructor approval.
Students are required to complete the assignment using InDesign.
AI tools may be applied responsibly for supporting tasks such as generating placeholder text, sample images, illustration...
Submission must include InDesign working file (.INDD), exported outputs in required formats, packaged file folder, printed version (if requested), documentation of the idea development process and AI-generated content.
assessments.knowledgeSkill:
Demonstrate proficiency in using InDesign tools effectively.
Create professional layout projects such as magazines, brochures, and templates for print or digital publishing.
assessments.note: This project must be completed at home, and students are expected to integrate AI tools responsibly into their creative process.
